design_rule: Every rejection proves the pilot is NOT a legality engine: each invalid submission is constructed FORGED (not pilot-generated) and must fail closed with the exact existing protocol error; no fallback mapping may appear in any failure path.

negative_cases.invalid: selection count above max / below min

negative_cases.must_raise: PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID: numeric choice required for target_amount (already unit-proven by XmageFullGamePlayerBoundaryTest; S6 adds LIVE variant)
PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID: numeric choice out of range (unit-proven by outOfRangeNumericIsRejected; S6 adds LIVE variants)

negative_cases.invalid: option with missing boolean metadata (malformed frame)
unknown mana option; pool-for-colored mismatch is handled by productive-option guard
out-of-domain number (max+1; min-1; malformed non-integer numeric_choice)
negative_cases.must_raise: PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID: numeric choice out of range / must be integer

negative_cases.invalid: leg outside [min_i,max_i]; total outside [totalMin,totalMax]; wrong vector length; malformed element
negative_cases.must_raise: PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID (projection of isGoodValues; S6 implements joint validation first in Lab with identical predicate)

negative_cases.invalid: unknown mode id; selection count above 1
duplicate attacker selection; unknown block option
numeric_choice present where NO bounds authorized (schema confusion)
negative_cases.must_raise: PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID: numeric_choice not authorized by decision schema

negative_cases.invalid: pilot strategy returns out-of-domain int through the NEW path (choose_number returns max+1)
negative_cases.must_raise: FullGameProtocolError out-of-domain (Lab early check) — proves the new path has no clamp/fallback

protocol_semantics_source: XmageFullGameActionProjection (STALE_DECISION, PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID families) + ExternalPilotDecisionPolicy FullGameProtocolError guards; exact strings asserted as CONTAINS (not equality) to survive message-wording drift
s6_gate: 14 remaining classes have live rejection negatives (S6 hard gate); numeric classes carry both unit (already green) and live variants
